name: VIBE-GPT-Image
description: VIBE-GPT-Image is a multimodal benchmark that evaluates a model's ability to understand and generate responses grounded in images. It measures performance on tasks such as visual question answering, image captioning, and open-ended visual instruction following. The benchmark is intended to test image-grounded reasoning, factual grounding from visuals, and the fluency/appropriateness of generated multimodal outputs.
reputation: An emerging Hugging Face-hosted multimodal benchmark used in recent multimodal LLM evaluations, but not yet a broadly standardized community staple.
